description: A directive applied with `*` that creates or removes embedded views from a `TemplateRef`.
The blueprint of an `<ng-template>`; injected by structural directives.
Anchor where views can be created (`createEmbeddedView`, `createComponent`), moved or cleared.
The language after `*`: `key expr` maps to inputs, `let x = prop` reads from the context, `let x` reads `$implicit`.
Static method that types the template context for `let` variables.
